articles.title: Hot French startup ZML releases free product to speed inference across lots of AI chips
articles.summary: ZML, a hot French AI startup endorsed by Turing Award winner Yann LeCun, has now released ZML/LLMD, software that could make running AI less costly.

articles.title: AI chip maker SambaNova raises $1B at $11B valuation, 5 months after last mega round
articles.summary: AI chip maker SambaNova has raised at an $11B valuation months after Intel was rumored to be trying to buy it for about $1.6 billion.

articles.title: Meta just launched a new AI generator, Muse Image, and users are already pushing back over use of their photos
articles.summary: The new image-generating model has numerous use cases, including advertising and decorating, and creator-based opportunities.

articles.title: Why the rise of open source AI isn’t hurting Anthropic … yet
articles.summary: Open source models’ success isn’t coming at the expense of frontier labs. Instead, they each seem to capture two phases of the same life cycle.

articles.title: Microsoft joins AI cost-cutting trend by relying more on its own models
articles.summary: Microsoft is the latest Silicon Valley giant to cut back on its AI spending.

articles.title: Discord admits AI moderation bug wrongfully banned users over harmless images
articles.summary: The company confirmed that the issue had been affecting accounts since May, with an additional 200 users banned over the weekend before its team identified and fixed the problem.

articles.title: Claude Cowork expands to mobile and web
articles.summary: With this update, users can start a task from their desk, get status updates on their phone, and pick up the finished output later — even if their laptop is closed.

articles.title: Savi’s app aims to protect consumers from realistic AI scams like kidnappers demanding ransom
articles.summary: The company just raised $7 million in seed funding, and is launching its app for iPhone and Android on Tuesday.

articles.title: The first American autonomous ground vehicles are fighting in Ukraine
articles.summary: Forterra has deployed more than 100 of its self-driving ATVs in conflict zones in Ukraine.

articles.title: The ‘first’ AI-run ransomware attack still needed a human
articles.summary: An AI agent carried out the technical execution of a real-world ransomware attack for the first known time, but new details show a human still chose the victim, set up the infrastructure, and supplied stolen credentials — meaning it wasn't quite the fully autonomous cybercrime debut that last week's headlines suggested.

articles.title: US investors will soon get access to SK Hynix, another memory maker riding the AI boom
articles.summary: SK Hynix is experiencing a boom credited to AI. It will ride that to a multibillion-dollar U.S. IPO, expected to take place on Friday.

articles.title: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch on the fight to split off models from agents
articles.summary: "The reality is, when you're optimizing for production, you start looking at a price/performance," Guillermo Rauch tells TechCrunch.

articles.title: You can now customize Siri’s pace and expressivity in the latest iOS 27 beta
articles.summary: The update is part of Apple's broader effort to make Siri feel more natural and personal, as it rebuilds the assistant around generative AI.

articles.title: Every major tech layoff in 2026 that has name-checked AI
articles.summary: A running look — in reverse chronological order — at the bigger tech companies that have announced significant layoffs this year with AI as a stated factor.

articles.title: If you use Google, you’re training its AI. Here’s how to opt out.
articles.summary: Consider this a belated PSA: A recent change to Google’s privacy settings is allowing the company to store more of your data, including media such as “images, files, and audio and video recordings,” to improve its AI models.

articles.title: Microsoft lays off nearly 5,000 employees across Xbox, commercial sales
articles.summary: Microsoft cut around 4,800 roles, or 2.1% of its global workforce, on Monday — the latest in a series of layoffs that’s stoking fears of AI replacing jobs. The layoffs will hit Xbox and commercial sales the hardest.

articles.title: Reddit is using LLMs to solve a problem LLMs largely created
articles.summary: In the AI era, platforms have no choice but to fight fire with fire to cull spam.

articles.title: Station F ramps up as a launchpad for Europe’s hottest AI startups
articles.summary: Station F, a Paris-based startup hub founded by French billionaire Xavier Niel, is gearing up for a new edition of its F/ai accelerator program in a bid to strengthen its positioning as a stepping stone for promising AI startups.

articles.title: Amazon will stop accepting new customers for Mechanical Turk
articles.summary: These may be the last days of Amazon’s Mechanical Turk.

articles.title: New Google commercial imagines a Declaration of Independence written with help from AI
articles.summary: Two hundred and fifty years after the signing of the Declaration of Independence, a new commercial asks: What if the Founding Fathers had access to Google Workspace?

articles.summary: Will be built at firm's existing Georgia campus

articles.summary: Georgia Butler speaks with Luca Beltramino of EdgeConneX and the Italian Data Center Association, exploring Italy's expanding data center market, IDA's role in industry growth, and key investment opportunities.

articles.summary: Will lease 6.4MW of capacity at campus

articles.title: DCD Studio: Building a Norwegian data center startup, with Giorgio Sbriglia, TeraKraft
articles.summary: Seb Moss speaks with Giorgio Sbriglia of TeraKraft, discussing the trials and benefits of setting up a Norwegian data center.

articles.summary: Achieved the milestone on the 4th of July

articles.summary: Latest fusion company to secure backing from the tech giant

articles.title: IBM expands mainframe portfolio with new z17 and LinuxONE Systems offerings
articles.summary: Single frame and rack mount configurations help to address data center cost and space constraints, company said

articles.title: Massachusetts utilities ink contracts for 4.5 GWh of energy storage
articles.summary: One project, set for a former fossil power plant site, reflects the diverging fortunes of New England’s offshore wind and energy storage industries.

articles.title: The PJM market is working — don’t mistake progress for failure
articles.summary: Energy stakeholders should be focused on how to strengthen competitive markets, not abandon them, writes Todd Snitchler, president and CEO of the Electric Power Supply Association.

articles.title: Walmart signs nuclear PPA with Constellation to support Illinois operations
articles.summary: The companies said the deal marks Walmart’s first nuclear power purchase agreement and is “among the first of its kind between a large retailer and a nuclear energy facility in the United States.”

articles.title: CPS Energy to pay around $400M for Winter Storm Uri gas
articles.summary: CPS Energy alleged that Energy Transfer’s subsidiaries engaged in “unlawful and unconscionable price gouging” for natural gas, but a judge ruled against the utility.

articles.title: Exelon, FirstEnergy utilities’ RTO adder targeted by Maryland in FERC complaint
articles.summary: Maryland state agencies asked the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission to end an extra 0.5% return the transmission owners earn for being PJM Interconnection members.

articles.title: States are taking action on energy affordability as issue grows: report
articles.summary: U.S. regulators and lawmakers have taken more than 350 energy affordability actions so far this year, but the problem is persistent, say researchers from the North Carolina Clean Energy Technology Center.

articles.title: APS to convert retired coal units, adding 380 MW of natural gas
articles.summary: “Given Arizona’s increasing demand for around-the-clock energy and the long timelines for adding new generation, the conversion has proven to be a viable option,” APS said.

articles.title: FERC denies waiver for $2B gas-fired plant in PJM’s fast-track review
articles.summary: Giving Advanced Power Services a waiver from the PJM Interconnection’s rules could harm other project developers, the agency said.

articles.title: Southwestern Public Service wins $113M reliability grant from Texas
articles.summary: The Texas Energy Fund has allocated more than $4 billion as part of the state’s effort to boost grid reliability. The award to SPS covers a drone-based pole inspection program and live monitoring.

articles.title: AI is reshaping the grid. Utilities need capacity that can move faster.
articles.summary: New large loads arrive in months. Grid upgrades take years. Fast storage helps close the gap.

articles.title: India inaugurates nuclear-powered hydrogen production facility
articles.summary: The facility uses process heat from the Fast Breeder Test Reactor to produce hydrogen through the copper-chlorine thermochemical process developed by Indian researchers.

articles.title: Holtec and EDF submit UK SMR project proposal
articles.summary: US-based Holtec International and France-based EDF have submitted a joint proposal for up to four SMR-300 small modular reactors at the Cottam power plant site in Nottinghamshire in the UK.

articles.title: US federal loan to jumpstart AP1000 reactor supply chain
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy has conditionally committed to USD17.5 billion in loans to finance the purchase of long-lead items for up to 10 Westinghouse AP1000 reactors.

articles.title: OSGE signs agreement with Włocławek for SMR plant
articles.summary: The City of Włocławek and Orlen Synthos Green Energy have signed an agreement defining the principles of cooperation in connection with the construction of up to six BWRX-300 small modular reactors in the central Polish city.

articles.title: In pictures: Work on Paks II's new units
articles.summary: Concreting work has been taking place for unit 5 at the Paks II nuclear power plant in Hungary, while earthworks on unit 6's pit are said to be proceeding on schedule, as the new government continues its review of the project.

articles.title: Second Taipingling unit starts up
articles.summary: Unit 2 at the Taipingling nuclear power plant has attained a sustained chain reaction for the first time, China General Nuclear announced. The unit is the second of six Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors planned for the site in Guangdong province.

articles.title: Blykalla teams up with Hitachi for SMR deployment
articles.summary: Sweden's Blykalla and Hitachi Energy - the energy arm of Japan's Hitachi Group - have signed a memorandum of understanding to explore a long-term collaboration on enabling the deployment of next-generation lead-cooled advanced modular reactors.

articles.title: Polish developer applies for CfD for three SMR plants
articles.summary: Orlen Synthos Green Energy has applied to Poland's Minister of Energy for a Contract for Difference for the construction of a total of 14 BWRX-300 small modular reactors at three locations in Poland.

articles.title: First Nations group takes stake in Ontario nuclear plant
articles.summary: The Williams Treaties First Nations is investing CAD700 million (USD492 million) in Ontario Power Generation's project to build a BWRX-300 reactor - the Darlington New Nuclear Project - with the support of loan guarantees from federal and provincial programmes.

articles.title: In pictures: Akkuyu 2's inner dome lifted into place
articles.summary: The inner containment dome has been lifted into place at the second unit of Turkey's first nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Fuel loading begins at Slovakia's Mochovce 4
articles.summary: Slovenské elektrárne has begun loading nuclear fuel into Mochovce Nuclear Power Plant's fourth unit, marking the start of its active commissioning.

articles.title: Scottish sites suitable for nuclear new build, study says
articles.summary: Scotland has areas with "high potential" for new nuclear development from a technical perspective, according to a new siting study by Great British Energy - Nuclear, the UK government's nuclear delivery body.

articles.title: State support needed to make new Swiss reactors viable, report says
articles.summary: The construction of new nuclear power reactors in Switzerland is not competitive under current conditions, but would become profitable with state subsidies, risk mitigation and significantly lower construction costs, according to a study from ETH Zurich and the Paul Scherrer Institute.

articles.title: In pictures: Final module installed at Haiyang 4
articles.summary: The last large module - the CB20 containment water tank module - has been installed at unit 4 of the Haiyang nuclear power plant site in China's Shandong province, State Power Investment Corporation announced.

articles.title: Criticality for third US reactor ahead of 4 July deadline
articles.summary: Deployable Energy's Unity demonstration reactor has successfully achieved initial criticality at the National Reactor Innovation Center located at Idaho National Laboratory - which means the US has achieved the presidential goal set last year of three microreactors under Department of Energy authorisation to achieve initial

articles.title: SGE-led team targets 14 BWRX-300 SMRs in UK
articles.summary: Poland's SGE and a deployment team including Samsung C&T, Laing O'Rourke, Aecon Group and Google Cloud, have outlined plans for the privately financed deployment of 14 GE Vernova Hitachi BWRX-300 small modular reactors across three sites in the UK.

articles.title: TRISO fuel delivered for Kaleidos reactor experiment
articles.summary: The first shipment of fuel for full-power, full-temperature testing of Radiant's Kaleidos microreactor technology has been delivered to the National Reactor Innovation Center's Demonstration of Microreactor Experiments facility at Idaho National Laboratory.

articles.title: Fuel loading completed at Mochovce 4
articles.summary: Slovenské elektrárne has announced that all 349 nuclear fuel assemblies have been successfully loaded into Mochovce 4. The process took five days, and was completed on Friday 3 July.

articles.title: Second Taipingling unit begins supplying power
articles.summary: Unit 2 of the Taipingling nuclear power plant has begun supplying electricity to the grid for the first time, China General Nuclear announced. The unit is the second of six Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors planned for the site in Guangdong province.

articles.title: Ampera says it has 3D-printed microreactor module
articles.summary: US-based Ampera Inc says it has achieved what it calls a major milestone by completing the production of the first full-scale, 3D-printed nuclear reactor module.
